contested_claims.claim: How much of the History of the Patriarchs is Severus's work
sides: His: the third preface in his voice (SEV l.1997-2138); the first preface (SEV l.608-613); Renaudot cites the History as Severus's (REN l.12475-12476); Renaudot's source says Severus wrote the life of the patriarch Abraham (REN l.32122-32125)

Uncertain or limited: Evetts, the extent cannot be known and later lives are contemporary biographies (SEV l.153-166); Renaudot, later continuers named (REN l.1034-1037, 25850-25877), doubts his Greek (REN l.875-876), keeps him apart from the History's author (REN l.23683-23685)
